From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: SableTech POC kickoff recap  scope, metrics, next steps

Hi Mia 

Thanks again for a great kickoff earlier today. Quick recap so we're aligned and can get your team staged for the POC. If anything below needs to change, I'm happy to update and re-share.

High-level objectives
- Reduce average latency for user-facing LLM features from ~650ms to <200ms at 95th percentile.
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~40% vs current managed endpoint through batching and quantization.
- Validate prompt/eval suite for accuracy on SableTech's top-5 intents (search summarization, QA, rewrite, classification, routing).

POC scope (6 weeks)
1) Integration: Redwood hosted private deployment with a dedicated model runner for SableTech dev org.
2) Prompts & evals: We'll run your prompt set (attached) and run our standard regressions + custom pass/fail metrics.
3) Metrics: latency (p50/p95), tokens-per-call cost, generation quality (BLEU/ROUGE + human-annotated eval on 150 examples), stability (error rate). Target KPIs included above.
4) Owners:
   - Redwood: Marissa (sales lead) + Aditya (technical lead) + Rishi (inference tuning).
   - SableTech: Mia (product lead) + Devon (platform eng) + Legal for SOW.
5) Timeline:
   - Week 0 (this week): Access & config (service account, dataset upload, prompt set).
   - Week 1-2: Ingest prompt set & baseline runs.
   - Week 3-4: Optimization (batching, quantization profiles) and regression checks.
   - Week 5-6: Final runs, human eval, handoff + SOW review.

Access/setup steps we need from SableTech (items marked * are blockers):
- *Service account with read/write to S3 bucket for prompt sets and logs (Devon)
- SSH/Jump host + IP allowlist range (if you prefer private VPC) or API key for staged environment (Mia/Devon)
- Sample user traffic or representative payloads (150-300 examples)
- Security questionnaire (we'll attach a SOC2 summary; Legal will coordinate)

Attachments: SableTech_POC_requirements.pdf (prompt set + target examples)  please confirm the canonical prompt file.

Immediate next steps (my recommended):
- Devon: share the service account + S3 bucket details by end of day Friday (Nov 20).
- Mia: confirm the prompt set is final or send updates.
- Redwood: we'll provision a dedicated runner and share a staging endpoint + runbook within 48 hours of access.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for our Week 1 baseline sync. Thanks  excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
